title: Inspections
schemeHelp: When empty, a scheme is matched by inspection type, product and operation: product and operation first, then product only, then a general scheme
inspectQtyPlaceholder: Defaults to the scheme's sample size
inspectQtyPositive: The inspected quantity must be greater than 0
qtyMismatch: Passed and defective quantities must add up to the inspected quantity
resultRemarkPlaceholder: Optional, e.g. failed items and measured values
noCheckItems: No inspection scheme; inspect according to the shop-floor standard
inspectedWithDefect: Inspection completed and a defect record was created
